Messages.Author: izi
Messages.Body:
Inscription
Type: Equipment
Requires: Thaumaturgy
Equipment.
[tha] Put this equipment on a ready vampire and put a card that
requires Thaumaturgy from your hand on it (face up, out of play; this
acting vampire pays the cost of that card). The vampire with this
equipment can burn this equipment to use the basic Thaumaturgy ability
of that card.
[THA] As above, but the vampire can use the superior Thaumaturgy
ability of the card.

Can I put the Thaumaturgy card on it when equiping via Pier 13 or MOTS?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


MotS: Yes.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/24174a0d3e102363

Pier 13 is in the same boat: the vampire equipping it must meet the
requirements, and the Inscription goes on that vampire.
